visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman stands in a bright, narrow hallway with white built-in closets on both sides and a dark wood floor. She holds a bundle of various colorful dresses. A picture-in-picture window in the top left corner displays a man in a red athletic jacket speaking to the camera. (2) The woman models a floor-length white halter-neck dress with a slit at the back. She turns her back to the camera to show the open back design while touching her hair. (3) She switches to a black off-the-shoulder midi dress with a flared skirt, placing her hands in the side pockets. (4) The woman appears in a white off-the-shoulder dress with large puffed sleeves and a high thigh slit. She stands near the center of the hallway. (5) She puts on a long yellow satin slip dress. A brief clip from a movie is inserted, showing an actress in a similar yellow dress, followed by the woman mimicking the actress's over-the-shoulder pose. (6) Finally, she wears a vibrant pink/fuchsia dress with ruffled detailing and a halter neck. The man in the top left reacts with exaggerated expressions.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voice introduces the segment in English with a bright, forward pitch. Background music is an upbeat synth-pop track with a strong 4/4 electronic drum beat. (2) Female voice enters with moderate speed, speaking in Mandarin to explain the clothes. BGM remains constant at a medium-high volume. (3) A subtle digital 'pop' sound effect accompanies the cut to the first white dress. Male voice reacts with 'Ooh, I like that leg parting thing' with high vocal arousal and rising intonation. (4) As the outfits change, the male voice provides comedic commentary and numerical scores. The female voice maintains a casual, conversational tone with frequent upward inflections at the ends of questions. (5) During the yellow dress segment, the female voice becomes more narrative and explanatory. The male voice continues to interject with praise. (6) The audio concludes with a high-intensity shout from the male speaker ('ANYWHERE!'), showing maximum arousal and loudness before a quick fade.
